stories.headline: Bihar makhana reaches Greece: APEDA flags off 1-tonne Purnea consignment
stories.summary: APEDA facilitated the flag-off of a 1-metric-tonne consignment of popped (Phool) makhana from Purnea, Bihar to Greece on October 2, 2026 — the first direct commercial shipment under APEDA's export diversification programme. Sourced by Indo Global Export (Belouri, Purnea) and shipped via S.S. Foods Exports (New Delhi), the cargo travels Mundra Port to Piraeus. The Commerce Ministry says it fetched higher price realisation than the prevailing domestic market rate. The flag-off was chaired by Bihar Agriculture Minister Vijay Kumar Sinha with APEDA Chairman Abhishek Dev present. Context: India exported 7,000+ MT of makhana worth USD 22 million in FY 2025-26 to 20+ markets; Bihar grows 80-85% of India's makhana across 35,000+ hectares in 10 districts, and the state is drafting an Agri Export Policy.
stories.brief: Bihar makhana reaches Greece: APEDA flags off 1-tonne Purnea consignment. An economy-related story. Covered by 4 outlets, including DD India and The Tribune.

stories.headline: New Mokama rail bridge ready: trains may start October 5 after CRS safety inspection
stories.summary: The new double-line rail bridge over the Ganga at Mokama, built parallel to Rajendra Setu at a cost of Rs 1,491 crore, may open for train services on October 5, 2026, pending the Commissioner of Railway Safety's two-day inspection (Oct 3-4) covering the bridge structure, tracks, signalling, electrification and the 13-km Mokama-Rampur Dumra section upgrades. Trains could run at up to 90 kmph versus 40-50 kmph on the old bridge. A mega block until Oct 4 for non-interlocking work has cancelled or rerouted hundreds of trains in the Mokama-Barauni-Hathidah section; regular operations depend on final safety clearance.
stories.brief: New Mokama rail bridge ready: trains may start October 5 after CRS safety inspection. Covered by 4 outlets, including Patna Press and The Times of India.

stories.headline: ECR to run 17 pairs of festival special trains to manage Durga Puja, Diwali and Chhath rush
stories.summary: East Central Railway announced it will operate at least 17 pairs of festival special trains on multiple routes from stations under its jurisdiction for the Durga Puja, Diwali and Chhath passenger rush, ECR chief public relations officer Saraswati Chandra said. Services include the weekly Chelapalli–Danapur special (Oct 4–Nov 29), Hyderabad–Danapur (Oct 3–Nov 30), Chelapalli–Sasaram, Patna–Chelapalli, Chandigarh–Patna, Ferozepur Cantt–Patna and a daily Anand Vihar–Patliputra service from October 1 to November 30.
stories.brief: ECR to run 17 pairs of festival special trains to manage Durga Puja, Diwali and Chhath rush. Covered by Times of India and Daily Jagran.

stories.headline: Dry weather over Bihar till October 3, no rain alert; daytime temperatures rising
stories.summary: The Meteorological Centre has not issued a rain alert for any district in Bihar till October 3, with generally dry weather continuing and rising daytime temperatures adding to the discomfort. Rainfall activity is expected to remain weak from September 30 to October 3, with rain expected to return from October 3–4. Bihar has recorded 31% less rainfall than normal this monsoon season.
stories.brief: Dry weather over Bihar till October 3, no rain alert; daytime temperatures rising. A weather-related story. Covered by Patna Press and Times of India.

stories.headline: JD(U) MLA Anant Singh accompanies Jan Suraaj's Anuj Singh for Patna Graduates MLC nomination, vows to defeat own party's Neeraj Kumar
stories.summary: Mokama MLA Anant Singh on October 1 joined Jan Suraaj Party candidate Anuj Singh during his nomination filing for the Patna Graduates' seat in the Bihar Legislative Council polls and held a roadshow with supporters. Singh said he would campaign to defeat JD(U)'s official candidate and sitting MLC Neeraj Kumar, citing their rivalry dating back to the 2015 Assembly elections.
stories.brief: JD(U) MLA Anant Singh accompanies Jan Suraaj's Anuj Singh for Patna Graduates MLC nomination, vows to defeat own party's Neeraj Kumar. A politics-related story. Covered by 4 outlets, including The Hindu and The Economic Times.

stories.headline: JD(U) leaders hit back at Sonia Gandhi over reported 'traitor' jibe at Nitish Kumar
stories.summary: After reports that Congress leader Sonia Gandhi called former Bihar CM Nitish Kumar a 'traitor' at a Congress Working Committee meeting in Delhi, JD(U) leaders responded sharply on October 1. Union minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh 'Lalan' said Kumar 'does not need Sonia Gandhi's certificate', working president Sanjay Jha said the Congress was belatedly realising Kumar's value, and Bihar minister Ashok Choudhary called Kumar a 'Vikas Purush'.
stories.brief: JD(U) leaders hit back at Sonia Gandhi over reported 'traitor' jibe at Nitish Kumar. A politics-related story. Covered by 4 outlets, including Forever News (IANS) and Asianet Newsable (ANI).

stories.headline: Chirag Paswan's attacks on Bihar NDA government over law and order seen as deliberate alliance strategy
stories.summary: Union minister and LJP (Ram Vilas) chief Chirag Paswan's repeated criticism of the BJP-led NDA government in Bihar over law and order, including saying he felt 'ashamed' to support it, is part of a larger political strategy to assert his party's leverage, per an October 1 Indian Express analysis. On September 29, Bihar minister Lakhendra Paswan took a dig at Chirag, saying he 'rarely visits Bihar' and should talk to the government directly.
stories.brief: Chirag Paswan's attacks on Bihar NDA government over law and order seen as deliberate alliance strategy. A politics-related story. Covered by The Indian Express and The Hindu.

stories.headline: Bihar to buy 25% of products from in-state industries, CM announces at Rising Bihar Investor Summit
stories.summary: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced at the Rising Bihar Investor Summit 2026, held October 1 at Hotel Taj City Centre, Patna, that the state government will purchase 25% of products manufactured by Bihar-based industries if they meet prescribed quality standards. He said the government is revising its procurement policy to give priority to in-state manufacturers and is building roads, power and water infrastructure to support industrial growth.
stories.brief: Bihar to buy 25% of products from in-state industries, CM announces at Rising Bihar Investor Summit. An economy-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including Patna Press and Nation Press.

stories.headline: AIIMS Patna signs MoU with Jhpiego to strengthen maternal and newborn care in Bihar
stories.summary: AIIMS Patna and Jhpiego signed a Memorandum of Understanding to collaborate on maternal and newborn health, implementation research, capacity building, midwifery and healthcare innovation. The agreement was signed by AIIMS Patna executive director Prof. (Brig.) Dr Raju Agarwal and Jhpiego India country director Dr Amit Shah during a high-level roundtable on building a continuum of care from pre-pregnancy through the postnatal period.
stories.brief: AIIMS Patna signs MoU with Jhpiego to strengthen maternal and newborn care in Bihar. A health-related story. Covered by The Times of India and Patna Press.

stories.headline: Patna startup Navmarg among 54 finalists in Vande Bharatam innovation campaign
stories.summary: Navmarg Research and Innovation Private Limited, a Patna-based startup, was selected among 54 finalists from around 26,000 participants in the nationwide Vande Bharatam entrepreneurship and innovation campaign. Co-founders Arpit Kumar and Abhijit Kumar also earned a place in a 10-day special mentorship programme. Navmarg's patented MARU magnetic-separation system removes arsenic from drinking water without chemical dosing and has delivered over 3.19 million litres of safe water in field deployments.
stories.brief: Patna startup Navmarg among 54 finalists in Vande Bharatam innovation campaign. An economy-related story. Covered by Indian Masterminds and Press Network of India.

stories.headline: Bihar's Vaibhav Suryavanshi named to TIME100 Next 2026, only Indian athlete on list
stories.summary: Cricketer Vaibhav Suryavanshi has been named to TIME's TIME100 Next 2026 list of 100 rising figures shaping the future, featuring in the 'Phenom' category. At 15, he is the youngest person on this year's list and the only Indian athlete among seven athletes selected. His rapid rise includes an IPL debut for Rajasthan Royals, a 35-ball IPL century, and a starring role in India's ICC Under-19 World Cup 2026 title win where he scored 175 in the final.
stories.brief: Bihar's Vaibhav Suryavanshi named to TIME100 Next 2026, only Indian athlete on list. Covered by The Indian Express and Patna Press.

stories.headline: EOU raids Bihar transport department sub-inspector Amit Kumar Gupta over Rs 1.49 crore disproportionate assets
stories.summary: The Economic Offences Unit registered a disproportionate-assets case against Amit Kumar Gupta, an Enforcement Sub-Inspector in Bihar's Transport Department, alleging assets worth Rs 1,49,58,500 — about 148.10% beyond his known legitimate income during 13 years of service. Searches at his Patna (Sai Vardaan City, Danapur) and Ara/Awadhpuri (Bhojpur) premises recovered around Rs 3 lakh in cash, an electric car, documents for 11 plots across Ara, Patna and Chhapra, and passbooks/chequebooks linked to 15 bank accounts, with funds frozen and a bank locker identified for a further search.
stories.brief: EOU raids Bihar transport department sub-inspector Amit Kumar Gupta over Rs 1.49 crore disproportionate assets. A crime-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including ABP Live and Times of India.

stories.summary: Two chain-snatching incidents hit Patna on the morning of September 30: a motorbike-borne pair, including a woman, snatched a gold chain worth about Rs 7 lakh from Pankaj Kumar in Kurji under the Digha police station area, and a separate man-and-woman duo robbed contractor Rakesh Singh of a chain valued at about Rs 5 lakh in Gardanibagh. Police are scanning CCTV footage and Digha SHO Avnish Kumar clarified no firearm was used.
stories.brief: Twin chain-snatchings in Patna's Kurji and Gardanibagh; Rs 12 lakh in gold stolen within hours. A crime-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including Patna Press and Punjab Kesari (IANS).

stories.headline: 31 Afghan nationals obtained Indian passports using Bihar addresses, MHA alerts state police
stories.summary: The Union Home Ministry and Ministry of External Affairs alerted Bihar police after it emerged that 31 Afghan nationals — 30 issued against Patna addresses and one against a Darbhanga address — obtained Indian passports through fraudulent means, alongside two Bangladeshi nationals. The MHA/MEA directed district magistrates and SSPs/SPs across the state to investigate and report, placing the police verification process used for passport issuance under scrutiny.
stories.brief: 31 Afghan nationals obtained Indian passports using Bihar addresses, MHA alerts state police. A crime-related story. Covered by New Indian Express and ETV Bharat.

stories.headline: Vigilance raids Patna ADM (Supply) Ravindra Kumar Diwakar and sub-registrar wife; Rs 79.98 lakh cash and 48 watches seized
stories.summary: Bihar's Vigilance Bureau raided the premises of Patna ADM (Supply) Ravindra Kumar Diwakar and his wife Kumari Sweety, a sub-registrar in Begusarai, recovering about Rs 79.98 lakh in cash (Rs 70.53 lakh from their Patna flat and Rs 9.44 lakh in Begusarai), jewellery worth about Rs 52.6 lakh, 48 expensive watches valued at about Rs 6 lakh, and seven immovable properties with a declared value of about Rs 2.92 crore. A disproportionate-assets case was registered on September 25 under the Prevention of Corruption Act.
stories.brief: Vigilance raids Patna ADM (Supply) Ravindra Kumar Diwakar and sub-registrar wife; Rs 79.98 lakh cash and 48 watches seized. A crime-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including Indian Express and ETV Bharat.

stories.headline: PMC collects record Rs 3.61 crore-plus in property tax on last penalty-free day
stories.summary: Patna Municipal Corporation collected a record Rs 3.61 crore-plus in property tax from more than 1,900 properties on the last penalty-free day, the highest single-day property tax collection of the current financial year, surpassing the previous record of Rs 3.36 crore set on June 30. The New Capital Circle led with Rs 2.08 crore from 397 properties; the civic body also brought 303 new properties into the tax net, and counters stayed open late as 1.5% monthly penalties kicked in after the deadline.
stories.brief: PMC collects record Rs 3.61 crore-plus in property tax on last penalty-free day. A civic-infrastructure story. Covered by Times of India and Patna Press.

stories.headline: Tejashwi Yadav demands fresh polls in Bihar and Bengal over SIR; INDIA bloc announces Oct 2-8 'Save Democracy' marches
stories.summary: RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav on September 30 accused the BJP of staying in power by 'stealing votes' and demanded fresh elections in Bihar and West Bengal, calling the recent polls 'fraudulent' and raising concerns over the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge announced the INDIA bloc would hold district-level 'Save Democracy' marches from October 2 to 8 and march to the Election Commission on October 6.
stories.brief: Tejashwi Yadav demands fresh polls in Bihar and Bengal over SIR; INDIA bloc announces Oct 2-8 'Save Democracy' marches. A politics-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including Asianet Newsable (ANI) and Devdiscourse.

stories.headline: BJP names four candidates for Bihar MLC polls; NDA allies split the eight seats 4-4
stories.summary: The BJP on September 29 announced candidates for four of the eight Bihar Legislative Council seats going to polls on October 23: Nawal Kishore Yadav from Patna Teachers, N K Yadav from Kosi Graduates, Sarvesh Kumar from Darbhanga Graduates and Narendra Prasad Singh from Tirhut Teachers. The BJP and its NDA ally JD(U), fielding candidates on the other four seats, divided the seats equally. The RJD has declared candidates for six seats and Jan Suraaj for all eight.
stories.brief: BJP names four candidates for Bihar MLC polls; NDA allies split the eight seats 4-4. A politics-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including The Hindu and India TV News.

stories.summary: Patna Police busted a cyber fraud network operating from the Musallahpur area and arrested four people accused of targeting customers in India and abroad — allegedly using malware, APKs and internet-based calling to pose as tech support and demand money for fake computer repairs. Around Rs 3.5 lakh in linked bank accounts has been frozen.

stories.summary: Panic at Munger Engineering College hostel after more than three dozen students — and some staff — fell ill with vomiting, diarrhoea, fever and weakness. They were treated at Sadar Hospital and most were discharged. Vishwakarma Puja prasad served on campus is suspected, but the exact cause is unconfirmed and an enquiry has been ordered.

stories.summary: Authorities announced fresh measures to reduce bird-strike risk at Patna's Jayprakash Narayan International Airport — curbs on garbage heaps, meat and fish shops and laser lights within about 10 km of the airport. The move follows recent bird-related flight disruptions, including an IndiGo diversion to Varanasi.
stories.brief: Patna airport steps up bird-strike prevention drive. A civic-infrastructure story. Covered by Facebook (News18 Bihar/Jharkhand) and Patna Press.

stories.summary: Patna Civil Court received a bomb threat by email, prompting evacuation of the premises and searches by police, bomb disposal and dog squads. No suspicious object was found. It is the latest in a recurring series of hoax email threats to the court.
stories.brief: Patna Civil Court evacuated after email bomb threat; nothing found. A crime-related story. Covered by Facebook (NBT Bihar) and Patna Press.

stories.brief: Liquor smuggling via Ganga river route busted near Patna. A crime-related story. So far carried by Facebook (News18 Bihar/Jharkhand).

stories.summary: Thousands of government job aspirants marched from Gandhi Maidan toward the CM's residence demanding cancellation and re-examination of the 70th BPSC exam and Daroga (sub-inspector) recruitment over alleged irregularities.
